name: Balmazújváros (Hungary)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the town arms of Balmazújváros (a blue and green shield with a yellow bird, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and grey mantling) above the name BALMAZÚJVÁROS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Balmazújváros arms with helm, crest and mantling
